sentences.text:
The petitioner has filed this petition seeking following relief:-
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this
petition and to direct the police authorities to immediately arrest the accused persons
of the case bearing Crime No.45/2023 registered by the police of Police Station
Duldula, District Jashpur (C.G.) for the offences under Section 376 (2) (n), 506 Read
with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code against the accused persons, in the interest of
justice."
